entities.summary: Yulia Vladimirovna Tsvetkova is a Russian artist and activist from Komsomolsk-on-Amur. She is the organizer of the activist art festival Saffron Flower and the founder of the "Woman--not doll" project which destigmatizes the female body. She is also the director of the "Merak" youth theater. On 11 February 2020, she was recognized as a political prisoner.
